question: Which of the following is the only state in India that produces diamonds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**__ is the only state in India that produces diamonds.
 
• **Panna** in Madhya Pradesh is famous for diamond mining in India.
 
• Panna is famous by the name of ‘**The City of Diamonds**’.
 
• Since 2021, only** 77.72-carat diamond** has been discovered in Panna, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• For almost 3000 years, India was the world's only supply of diamonds until diamond resources were discovered in Brazil and South Africa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Madhya Pradesh is the** second-largest Indian state by area.**
 
• Until 2000, when the southeastern Chhattisgarh region was declared as a distinct state, Madhya Pradesh was India's largest by area.
 
• Madhya Pradesh is rich in mineral resources and contains India's greatest **diamond and copper reserves.**
 
• More than a third of Madhya Pradesh's land is covered with forest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kolkata** is the capital of West Bengal.

 
 
• Kolkata is recognised as India's Cultural Capital.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** has the second longest coastline in India after Gujarat.
 
 
• On October 1, 1953, Andhra Pradesh became India's first linguistically based state.
 
 
 
• **Uttarakhand** is known as the "Land of Gods"
